prompts.seace:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create ONE very clear, professionally typeset FLOWCHART image, portrait 2:3 format, high resolution. It is an architecture teaching diagram in Spanish. This is a replacement for an overly decorative illustration: prioritize a visibly traceable logical flow, NOT an illustrated scene. At least 85% of the canvas must be actual diagram nodes, section bands and directional connectors. ZERO characters, desks, machines, isometric rooms, perspective, paper piles, decorative backdrops or faux web screenshots. Only tiny flat functional icons may appear in headings.
Art direction: clean warm-ivory rectangular cards with black text on a dark charcoal background; terracotta section heading for reading, violet section heading for company evaluation. Discreet hand-inked outline character reminiscent of educational engineering diagrams, but excellent alignment, generous spacing and large sans-serif typography. All cards face the viewer flat. Draw conspicuous thick terracotta DOWN ARROWS between every successive main node, with large unmistakable triangular arrowheads. The whole main flow is ONE VERTICAL COLUMN. Never use a serpentine or sideways reading order. No floating disconnected nodes. Distinct shapes: rounded rectangles for actions, diamond for a yes/no decision if specified, cylinder for PostgreSQL.
Layout: large title and short subtitle. Upper grouped panel labelled "A · LECTURA" contains steps 1–5 in a single vertical column. Below them, a large central PostgreSQL cylinder. A clearly dashed vertical connector crosses a roomy divider labelled "Proceso separado · solo lecturas utilizables". Lower grouped panel labelled "B · EVALUACIÓN DIN" contains steps 6–8 in the SAME vertical main column. A SMALL left-side company-profile box connects with one thick horizontal arrow INTO step 6 only. The company folder is a second input, not a sequential step. Use a wider main card and a small side input so long words remain readable. One small optional right-side branch from the database says "Ficha en la web"; never route it into the score. Step 6 is the only entry point to the evaluation, NOT step 7. Main path: 1 ↓ 2 ↓ 3 ↓ 4 ↓ 5 ↓ database ↓ 6 ↓ 7 ↓ 8. Leave plenty of vertical room. Section B begins AFTER the database. Use exactly one number badge per numbered step; no duplicate numbers.
Keep text short and EXACTLY as provided. No miniature invented interface text, dates or real company scores. At the bottom: one short takeaway "LLM1 estructura · JEV y reglas puntúan · LLM2 explica". No other explanatory paragraphs. Any score representation must be text "0–100", never a gauge. The final result is saved in PostgreSQL, expressed within the final card caption rather than a long confusing return arrow. No infinite arrows or loops. The image depicts the logical architecture, not running-service status.
Title: "SEACE · PROD2"
Subtitle: "De la búsqueda a la evaluación de DIN"
Upper reading panel has a small annotation "Cola de trabajo: Redis".
Main nodes:
1 rounded rectangle, heading "Buscar y seleccionar IDs", caption "Keywords · fechas · metadatos".
2 rounded rectangle, heading "Comprobar identidad y apertura", caption "ID + hash · reutilizar históricos".
3 diamond, text "¿JEV comercial ≥ 60?" A large DOWN arrow labelled "Sí" leads ONLY to step 4. A short LEFT side arrow labelled "No" goes to one small terminal "Conservar descarte". This side branch ends there. No connection from the discarded node to any later stage.
4 rounded rectangle, heading "Preparar documentos y contexto", two short caption lines "Selección JEV · OCR parcial" and "Embeddings V5 · OpenAI".
5 rounded rectangle with subtle terracotta highlight, heading "LLM1 · Gemini", caption "Texto → requisitos, citas y categorías".
Central cylinder: "PostgreSQL", smaller line "Ficha · cronograma · lectura estructurada".
Dashed connector from cylinder, through divider "Proceso separado · solo lecturas utilizables", MUST enter step 6.
Left side input box near step 6, heading "Perfil DIN", two short lines "Rubros · experiencia" and "Montos · profesionales". Arrow points directly from this box into step 6, not step 7.
6 rounded rectangle, heading "JEV + reglas", caption "Comparar capacidades · puntaje 0–100".
7 rounded rectangle with violet highlight, heading "LLM2 · Gemini Flash-Lite", caption "Explicar brechas y acciones", smaller line "No recalcula el puntaje".
8 rounded rectangle, heading "Resultado en BuenaPro", caption "Puntaje provisional · brechas · detalle", smaller line "Evaluación guardada en PostgreSQL".
Footer takeaway as specified. A discreet additional footer note "RUC/RNP no restan puntos" is allowed.
Accuracy: selected-ID route, opening before new models. Redis schedules tasks; it does NOT replace LLM1 or write final readings directly. Embeddings retrieve text; LLM1 receives recovered text rather than complete PDFs. Never add notifications, R2 uploads or automatic evaluation coupling. Keep every main connection visibly vertical and unambiguous.
